frozen_frame.observation:
S0: missing parts of shoes of two players, incorrectly segmenting an object in front of player.
S2: players are well segmented, only minimal wrong pixels, player correctly selected through a the basket mesh
S3: missing a shoe, not selecting through the basket mesh, incorrectly selecting on object in front of a player, missing one shoe
S4: missing part of the player moving the fastest and most blurry because of this movement, slight wrong selection of pixels near a person, player correctly selected through the basket mesh

motion.observation: Could not compare. Playback does not work.

artifacts.observation: Artifacts can happen when rendering after learning. The is only a segmentation test so it cannot produce artifacts.

sharpness.observation: Sharpness needs to be evaluated on final rendering.

overall.observation: The segmentation needs to be the best for the players close to the ball because it's what viewers will focus on. S2 seems the best overall.

human_review.tradeoffs: S3 is better at segmenting the crowd but this does not matter because it's not the focus of the video.

segmentation.scope: historical component observation; not current metric-depth selection

frozen_frame.observation:
D0, D1, D3: they have a depth artifact on edge of close object.
D4: does not have this artifact on edge of close object. This probably works better. However, the farthest objects like the crown are not captured or they have depth values difficult to see for the naked eye.

motion.observation: Motion is irrelevant for this test.

artifacts.observation: Artifacts are irrelevant for this test.

sharpness.observation:
As mentionned in frozen_frame, D0, D1, D3 have something that looks like sharpness cranked too high that causes artifacts on the edge of clone objects.
D4 is less sharp but looks much better.

human_review.tradeoffs: D4 is less sharp but looks much better.

depth.scope: historical component observation; not current metric-depth selection

human_review.observation: D2 also has an issue with the depth on edges of close objects and it's much worse than D0 and D1. D2 also has difficulty capturing a far player compared to the other methods.
